Prior PASS covers the older reader only. No source writes, real acceptance events, ROI/IOD changes, calibration promotion or producer reruns merely to fix reporting. Use locked Pixi; report exact revision and limits.

Fix the smallest accepted issue, run appropriate locked recovery-environment controls, record source/test pins and exact commands/exits, then freeze again. Do not change sources, existing outputs, Methods, masks or recovery acceptance state.
